text: This application proposes to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit the redevelopment of the subject site with a 23-storey mixed use building. A total of 335 dwelling units are proposed and a total gross floor area (GFA) of 21,167 square metres, including 386 square metres of first floor retail/commercial floor space. The proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Planning Statement (2024). The proposed development is also consistent with the general intent of the City's Official Plan and complies with Site and Area Specific Policy (SASP) 127 by proposing residential and retail/commercial uses only. It will intensify a site along a major street that is well served by both surface transit and emerging higher order transit networks.
